topic: Choose a coffee machine for the shared office kitchen

scenario.topic: Choose a coffee machine for the shared office kitchen
scenario.opening_question: When picking a coffee machine for our office kitchen, what matters most to you: speed, coffee quality, ease of use, or maintenance?

options.name: Breville BES870XL Barista Express Espresso Machine
options.upside: Offers high-quality espresso with built-in grinder and customizable settings.
options.tradeoff: Requires some skill and time to operate and clean properly.
options.concern: Heavier and takes up more counter space compared to simpler machines.
options.best_for: users who prioritize coffee quality and customization.

options.name: Keurig K-Elite Single Serve Coffee Maker
options.upside: Very fast and convenient single-serve brewing with a wide variety of pods.
options.tradeoff: Coffee quality is less rich and pods create more waste.
options.concern: Limited to pod flavors and less environmentally friendly.
options.best_for: users who want speed and convenience over coffee complexity.

options.name: Nespresso VertuoPlus Coffee and Espresso Maker
options.upside: Produces rich espresso and coffee with easy capsule system and fast brewing.
options.tradeoff: Capsules are more expensive and less variety than ground coffee options.
options.concern: Smaller water tank means more frequent refills.
options.best_for: users who want a balance of quality and quick, easy use.

options.name: Hamilton Beach FlexBrew 2-Way Coffee Maker
options.upside: Offers both single-serve pod brewing and full pot brewing flexibility.
options.tradeoff: Slower brew time and less specialized for espresso quality.
options.concern: More complex to clean and maintain due to dual brewing systems.
options.best_for: users who want versatility and the option to brew multiple servings.

shared_context: The office kitchen is shared by exactly 3 team members who all drink coffee daily.
The budget for the coffee machine is capped at $500.
The machine should fit on a standard countertop with limited space.

personas.name: Pavel
personas.background: Pavel recently started working remotely and wants a coffee machine that lets him experiment with espresso drinks at home.
personas.private_goal: To have a high-quality espresso machine that allows for customization and a premium coffee experience.

personas.name: Zara
personas.background: Zara has a busy schedule and often drinks coffee between meetings, so she values speed and convenience highly.
personas.private_goal: To have a fast, easy-to-use coffee machine that minimizes wait time and cleanup.

personas.name: Lila
personas.background: Lila manages office supplies and wants a versatile machine that can serve both single users and groups during meetings.
personas.private_goal: To have a flexible coffee maker that can brew single cups or full pots to accommodate different office needs.
